title: Amani Spa & Wellness — Ikeja GRA, Lagos
description: Spa rituals, massages, floatation and facials in Ikeja GRA. See the full menu and book your treatment online.

hero.headlineHtml: Invest in falling in love with you.
hero.text: Massages, floatation, facials and full spa rituals in a calm space in Ikeja GRA. See every treatment and price in one place, then book your time. No PDF menus or WhatsApp back-and-forth.

items.title: A Slowed Moment
items.text: 60-minute aroma wellbeing massage and a 30-minute pressure-point foot massage.

items.title: Stress & Burnout Recovery
items.text: 30 minutes in the floatation pool, a 60-minute stress-release massage and a 15-minute scalp massage.

items.title: Revival Renewal Ritual
items.text: Aroma stress-release massage and ESSE express facial, with Amani Immune Boost Oil to take home.

items.title: August Hush
items.text: Body exfoliation, deep tissue massage and ESSE express facial. Book for two and both get an upgrade.

feature.title: Festive Bliss
feature.text: 30-minute body polish, 60-minute hot stones massage, 15-minute aroma mud back mask and a 45-minute express facial with jade-stone facial massage. On the live site, seasonal offers like this go live with one click and can be booked and paid for straight away.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site you pick a date and time and pay with Paystack. Gift it to someone else too.

booking.title: Book a treatment
booking.text: Choose your ritual and time and we'll confirm by WhatsApp. Booking for two? Add your guest below.
terms: 38/40 Isaac John Street, Ikeja GRA, Lagos.
Please arrive 15 minutes early to settle in.
